36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
90193: Nozomi Kaminashi is the main protagonist of Keijo!!!!!!!!. She was a student at Setouchi Keijo Training School. She previously resided in Room 309 before being promoted to the Elite Class.
90194: Kaminashi's first friend and rival. Before Keijo used to be a judo's athlete, she was the Japan's hope for a golden medal in the Olympics but threw it all away in the qualifications. She has a complex about her bust size and Kaminashi usually makes fun about it.
90195: She is a student at Setouchi Keijo Training School, a former resident of Room 309 and currently a member of the Elite Class.
90196: Non Toyoguchi was a student at Setouchi Keijo Training School. She previously resided in Room 309 before being promoted to the Elite Class.
121783: Hanabi Kawai was a student at Setouchi Keijo Training School. She was ranked third in the Elite Class.
131174: She's a student at Setouchi Keijo Training School, and a member of the Elite Class in said school, where she ranked first place in the entrance exam. She's an infighter, and has a pretty wide range of special techniques at her disposal.
136254: Saya Kogatana was a student at Setouchi Keijo Training School. She was ranked sixth in the Elite Class.
136255: Nagisa Ujibe is a former champion Keijo player. She is currently working at Setouchi Keijo Training School as an instructor. During her youth, she was able to attain the rank Prize Queen, and was nicknamed as the Siren.
136256: Kyoko Shirayuk is an A-Rank Keijo player, affiliated with the Kansai's Kyoto Branch. Her mentor was Sanae Kirieda.
136257: Maya Sakashiro was a student at Suruga Keijo Training School. She was ranked second in Suruga. She is the adoptive daughter of Ayako Sakashiro, Suruga's coach and headmaster. Upon graduating from Suruga, Maya officially becomes a Keijo player.
136258: Sanae Hououin was a student at Suruga Keijo Training School. She was ranked third in Suruga. She is also nicknamed as the Suruga's Black Beast (駿河の黒き獣, Suruga no Kuroki Kemono), and Cheater (チート女, Chīto Onna). Upon graduating from Suruga, Sanae officially becomes a Keijo player.
